parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM job_hunter.jobs
     WHERE verdict_at > now() - interval '7 days')                  AS scored_7d,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM job_hunter.jobs
     WHERE llm_apply AND verdict_at > now() - interval '7 days')    AS alerted_7d,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(effective_status, n), '{}'::json)
     FROM (SELECT effective_status, count(*)::int AS n
           FROM job_hunter.application_status GROUP BY 1) s)        AS by_status;

parameters.query:
WITH req AS (
  SELECT unnest(string_to_array($1, ' '))::int AS id
),
found AS (
  SELECT r.id FROM req r JOIN job_hunter.jobs j ON j.id = r.id
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.applications (job_id, status, applied_at)
  SELECT id, 'applied', now() FROM found
  ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO UPDATE
    SET status     = 'applied',
        applied_at = COALESCE(job_hunter.applications.applied_at, now()),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE job_hunter.applications.status IN ('interested', 'applied')
  RETURNING job_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id ORDER BY job_id), '{}') FROM up)                  AS updated,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(id ORDER BY id), '{}') FROM found
     WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM up))                                         AS skipped,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(id ORDER BY id), '{}') FROM req
     WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM found))                                          AS not_found;

WITH req AS (
  SELECT unnest(string_to_array($1, ' '))::int AS id
),
found AS (
  SELECT r.id FROM req r JOIN job_hunter.jobs j ON j.id = r.id
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.applications (job_id, status, applied_at)
  SELECT id, $2::text,
         CASE WHEN $2::text IN ('applied', 'interviewing', 'offer', 'rejected') THEN now() END
  FROM found
  ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO UPDATE
    SET status     = EXCLUDED.status,
        applied_at = COALESCE(job_hunter.applications.applied_at, EXCLUDED.applied_at),
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING job_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id ORDER BY job_id), '{}') FROM up) AS updated,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(id ORDER BY id), '{}') FROM req
     WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM found))  AS not_found;

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS jobs
FROM (
  SELECT job_id, left(title, 60) AS title, company, url, updated_at
  FROM job_hunter.application_status
  WHERE effective_status = 'interested'
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 20
) t;

WITH req AS (
  SELECT unnest(string_to_array($1, ' '))::int AS id
),
del AS (
  DELETE FROM job_hunter.applications a
  USING req r
  WHERE a.job_id = r.id AND a.status = 'interested'
  RETURNING a.job_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id ORDER BY job_id), '{}') FROM del)            AS removed,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(id ORDER BY id), '{}') FROM req
     WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM del))                                   AS unchanged;

WITH req AS (
  SELECT unnest(string_to_array($1, ' '))::int AS id
),
found AS (
  SELECT r.id FROM req r JOIN job_hunter.jobs j ON j.id = r.id
),
cur AS (
  SELECT a.job_id, a.status
  FROM job_hunter.applications a JOIN found f ON f.id = a.job_id
),
del AS (
  DELETE FROM job_hunter.applications a
  USING found f
  WHERE a.job_id = f.id AND a.status = 'interested'
  RETURNING a.job_id
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO job_hunter.applications (job_id, status)
  SELECT id, 'interested' FROM found
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT job_id FROM cur)
  ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING job_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id), '{}') FROM ins)                            AS liked,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id), '{}') FROM del)                            AS unliked,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(job_id), '{}') FROM cur
     WHERE status <> 'interested')                                               AS skipped,
  (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(id), '{}') FROM req
     WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM found))                                     AS not_found;
